desc: The rule hierarchy: which rule governs right now, and can it be set aside. A defeasible-priority model: classes totally ordered by authority; specificity defeats generality within the order; suspension can temporarily disable some rules but not others. Also owns the order objects (adopted debate-limiting orders) that guard/no-order-precluding reads and timer/order-exhaustion expires.

classes.desc: procedural rules prescribed by federal/state/local law applicable to the body
corporate charter (certificate/articles of incorporation); also charters issued by a superior society to a subordinate unit
constitution when a separate document from bylaws; otherwise merged into bylaws
the combined basic instrument of the society
adopted rules of parliamentary procedure superseding the parliamentary authority
the adopted manual (RONR); binding where not inconsistent with anything above
administrative rules not about parliamentary procedure
hybrid class adopted per convention session; may modify parliamentary-authority rules; expires at end of session
established practice treated as if a rule until it conflicts with any written rule and a point of order is raised, whereupon it falls
default substrate for a body with no adopted rules

authority_order.NOTE(judgment): convention-standing-rules are placed as shown because they supersede the parliamentary authority for the session [59:27] but may not conflict with the society's bylaws [59:27]

override_rules.desc: specificity defeats generality within and across documents at the same level: a particular statement governs over a general one to which it is an exception
a special rule of order cannot supersede a parliamentary-authority rule that the authority says is alterable only in the bylaws
a rule's adoption/amendment/suspension treatment follows its content, not what the society calls it
other manuals are merely persuasive where the adopted authority is silent; never binding
precedent (chair rulings + appeal outcomes, with recorded reasons): persuasive only; weight grows with repetition and consistency; overridable by later ruling, appeal, or rule change

resolution.desc: The procedure behind guard/act-in-order-under-governing-rules: (1) collect rules whose subject covers the act (subject-coverage is a recorded classification per rule — see gaps.json); (2) resolve conflicts by authority_order, then override_rules (specificity, anti-delegation, content-not-name); (3) on residual ambiguity of a rule's meaning, apply interpretation principles as tie-breaker predicates; unresolved ambiguity routes to adjudication (society-decides, majority [56:68(1)]).

interpretation.desc: the society itself resolves ambiguity, by majority; no interpretation may contradict a clear meaning
prefer the reading that does not conflict with or nullify another provision
authorizing some things of a class prohibits the unmentioned things of that class
a granted privilege includes lesser privileges but prohibits greater ones
a prohibition/limitation blocks everything beyond it, permits what is less and unmentioned same-class things not evidently improper
a definite penalty may be neither increased nor diminished
a rule using only the general term applies to all specific terms wholly included under it

suspendibility.unless: the law provides for its own suspension
provision provides for own suspension, OR provision is in the nature of a rule of order (then two-thirds)

suspendibility.scope_limit: only rules applying within a meeting context; at most for the session

suspendibility.note: suspending BOTH the convention rule and the underlying general rule requires two-thirds; no suspension for remainder of session; single-application rules cannot be suspended (that would be rescission); the rule naming the parliamentary authority cannot be suspended as such

unsuspendable.desc: Absolutely unsuspendable, regardless of vote. Category membership per rule is content classification (content-not-name), recorded on the rule record; the categories are the closed list below.

examples: a particular member's right to attend, make motions, nominate, speak, give notice, vote — removable only by discipline

categories.desc: no rule protecting a minority of a given size may be suspended over the negative vote of that minority
a bylaw ballot requirement cannot be suspended so as to expose votes
rules with application outside the current session cannot be suspended (rescind/amend instead)
the order of business cannot be dispensed with entirely in advance; only passed over item-by-item or by proceeding to a subject (two-thirds)

suspension_mechanics: the motion names its PURPOSE, never the rules [25:4]; nothing beyond that purpose is authorized [25:4]; renewal for the same purpose barred within the same meeting but allowed after adjournment [25:6]; a defeated suspension's purpose may be reached instead at the class thresholds for rescind/amend if the rule is really a standing rule, etc. (route via change_thresholds)

change_thresholds.adopt: in bylaws (preferred); else as a special rule of order
two-thirds as a package if any rule individually needs two-thirds; parliamentary rules individually two-thirds, non-parliamentary individually majority
majority (two-thirds if session already has an order of business it conflicts with or if creating special orders there)

change_thresholds.fall: automatic upon point of order citing conflict with any written rule

continuing_breach_grounds.desc: Adopted acts that are null and void and remain attackable without timeliness limits (consumed by lifecycle for the continuing-breach window and by protocol for point-of-order admissibility). Ground-matching per act is content classification recorded via adjudication or rule data.

grounds.exception: session-scoped incidental main motion conflicting with a suspendible rule-of-order in bylaws, adopted at suspension threshold

order_objects.desc: Adopted debate-limiting orders are rules-state: schema.json types.Order, created on adoption of previous-question or limit-extend-debate forms, covering a consecutive series [15:5(2), 16:5(2)]. Ownership wiring (the three-part seam): rules holds the objects; guard/no-order-precluding and guard/pq-order-unexhausted / guard/debate-closing-order-active read them; timer/order-exhaustion (lifecycle.json) expires them. 15:18 / 16:11 is the shared spec all three cite.
